#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

long long f[181], n, ans;

long long Abs(long long a) {
    return a < 0 ? -a : a;
}

void recurse(int level, long long total_cost) {
    if (n == 0) {
        ans = min(ans, total_cost);
        return;
    }
    if (level == 0) return;

    for (int i = -10; i <= 10; ++i) {
        long long delta = i * f[level];
        if (n + delta > 0) {
            n += delta;
            recurse(level - 1, total_cost + Abs(i) * level);
            n -= delta;
            break;
        }
    }
    for (int i = -10; i <= 10; ++i) {
        long long delta = i * f[level];
        if (n + delta == 0) {
            n += delta;
            recurse(level - 1, total_cost + Abs(i) * level);
            n -= delta;
            break;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 10; i >= -10; --i) {
        long long delta = i * f[level];
        if (n + delta < 0) {
            n += delta;
            recurse(level - 1, total_cost + Abs(i) * level);
            n -= delta;
            break;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> n;
    f[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= 16; ++i) {
        f[i] = f[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    }
    ans = LLONG_MAX;
    recurse(16, 0);
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
